zh-CN.title: 误删的聊天记录可以找回了
items: 认证账号输入密码确认后，可恢复 1 次仅从自己这里删除的聊天记录
永久 VIP 额外获得 5 次恢复机会

en.title: Restore accidentally deleted chat history
items: Verified accounts can restore chat history deleted only from their own view once after password confirmation
Permanent VIP members receive 5 additional recoveries
